text.tspan: Literacy rate vs. GDP per capita 2024
Share of people aged 15+ who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement about their
everyday life. GDP per capita is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026); Eurostat, OECD, IMF, and World Bank (2026)
GDP per capita is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Where data for 2024 is unavailable, the value from the closest year
